name: Adeia Inc.
tagline: Leading IP Licensing Platform for Media, Entertainment and Semiconductors
hero_kpi_rationale: Croissance de 18% du chiffre d'affaires (67,4 millions USD supplémentaires), démontrant la forte traction commerciale de la plateforme de licences IP dans les secteurs des médias, divertissement et semi-conducteurs.

kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by IP licensing platform
kpis.description: Revenue increased from $376.0 million in 2024 to $443.4 million in 2025, representing an 18% year-over-year increase.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from fixed-fee and minimum-guarantee arrangements
kpis.signal: Stable recurring revenue base from established customer relationships
kpis.description: Recurring revenues increased from $341.5 million in 2024 to $351.3 million in 2025, representing a 3% year-over-year increase and demonstrating contract stability.

kpis.explanation: Total media and semiconductor patent assets worldwide
kpis.signal: Extensive IP portfolio supporting competitive advantage
kpis.description: Adeia maintains approximately 13,750 media and semiconductor patent assets worldwide, with approximately 80% generated from internal innovation engine.

kpis.signal: Lean, asset-light IP licensing business model
kpis.description: Adeia operates with approximately 150 full-time employees, substantially all located in the U.S., demonstrating an efficient asset-light business model.

stories_kpis.explanation: Company addressing AI as evolving technology and market opportunity
stories_kpis.signal: AI recognized as key consumer trend and innovation focus area
stories_kpis.description: Adeia's innovations address massive proliferation of entertainment content and evolving technology including artificial intelligence, positioning the company for next-generation solutions.

stories_kpis.explanation: Dual-industry IP licensing platform serving entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor sectors
stories_kpis.signal: Differentiated IP licensing business across complementary industries
stories_kpis.description: Adeia operates a leading IP licensing platform with extensive portfolio of media and semiconductor intellectual property, enabling customers to build next-generation solutions for global markets.

ai_positioning.summary: La société ADEA n'a pas mentionné l'intelligence artificielle, le machine learning ou des termes similaires dans les extraits fournis de son document 10-K. Par conséquent, sa position sur l'IA ne peut être déterminée à partir de ces informations.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
